notes.title: 1 days until the release of "Song of Life"
notes.notes:
1 days until the release of "Song of Life"!

The historical fiction visual novel "Song of Life" set in the Three Kingdoms period is officially set to release on March 4th.

The game is set in the late Han Dynasty. Years of war and disasters have brought misery to the people, and plagues are rampant. Players will play as three divine doctors traveling across China, seeking to save the people. Now, let us go to the troubled times of the late Han Dynasty, transform into divine doctors who relieve suffering and save the world, fight against the raging plague, and find the truth that led to the chaos of this era!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43919121/9ca590cd8facdaa77f88755e76f6f00df6fd3d31.jpg[/img]
